issue_context.title: azure: PV hangs forever in failed deletion because the underlying disk is not found
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

The fix from https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102083 seems to be incomplete/wrong. When disk is not found, the GET call for the disk fails with `404 Not Found` and it is not even reaching the DELETE call.

### What did you expect to happen?

PV to be deleted (its `kubernetes.io/pv-protection` finalizer to be removed) when the underlying disk is already gone.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. Create a PVC.

2. Locate the created Azure disk and delete it manually.

3. Then, delete the PVC.

4. Make sure that corresponding PV fails to be deleted with reason:

```yaml
status:
  message: 'Retriable: false, RetryAfter: 0s, HTTPStatusCode: 404, RawError: Retriable:
    false, RetryAfter: 0s, HTTPStatusCode: 404, RawError: {"error":{"code":"ResourceNotFound","message":"The
    Resource ''Microsoft.Compute/disks/foo''
    under resource group ''bar'' was not found. For more details please
    go to https://aka.ms/ARMResourceNotFoundFix"}}'
  phase: Failed
```

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
